segmentation.text: shall cross only in accordance with the official traffic-control devices pertaining to such crossing movements.

elements.justification: 'cross diagonally' is read as in NRS_484B_287_1d: the pedestrian's footprint overlaps an intersection (st.intersection, 'the region where two roadways meet'; rel.occupies 'a road user's footprint overlaps a lane / region') and its velocity is oblique to every lane that runs into it (st.lane_enters, kind st.lane), read through drv.motion.moving_across_carrier at the along/across tolerance and the right-angle tolerance. 'authorized' by official traffic-control devices (DEF-NRS-484A-145: every 'sign, signal, marking and device') is read through the marking that indicates the crossing: a marked crosswalk (st.crosswalk, 'marked crossing'; DEF-NRS-484A-065 (2) 'distinctly indicated for pedestrian crossing by lines or other markings') under the pedestrian's footprint. The crossing begins where the footprint comes to overlap the intersection.
'pedestrians' (DEF-NRS-484A-165: 'a person afoot, a person in a manual or motorized wheelchair ...') is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-165::pedestrian.

'the official traffic-control devices' (DEF-NRS-484A-145: 'every sign, signal, marking and device ... for the purpose of regulating, warning or guiding traffic', and traffic (DEF-NRS-484A-285) includes 'pedestrians') that regulate a pedestrian's crossing are pedestrian signal heads (dev.pedestrian_signal: 'a pedestrian head; state ∈ {walk, dont_walk_flashing, dont_walk_steady, dark}; countdown attribute when a timer is displayed'). 'pertaining to such crossing movements' ties the head to the crossing the words refer to ('such'): the diagonal crossing of the intersection the pedestrian enters. The head is tied to that intersection by dev.governs ('the travel regions whose traffic the device controls ... or an intersection, read as control of the junction itself'), the intersection being re-bound in the obligation with the whole selection of s2 (st.intersection whose overlap by the subject's footprint, rel.occupies, rises at this observation, with every lane entering it, st.lane_enters, st.lane, crossed obliquely through drv.motion.moving_across_carrier). A head governing a different intersection, or none, does not pertain to the crossing. Among the heads governing that intersection, the one pertaining to the diagonal movement is the one the pedestrian faces across the crossing: its position (dev.position, 'location of the device head / sign face') lies ahead of the pedestrian's position (kin.position) along its heading (kin.heading, 'direction the body points') within a cone and a reach; heads for the other crossings of the junction, beside or behind the pedestrian, are left out. dev.position is used as the head's location, not as a stop line or crossing, which its 'Not a stand-in for' clause excludes. 'in accordance with' is read through the indication shown when the crossing begins: walk, or a flashing indication with a countdown, accords; a steady don't-walk or a flashing one without countdown does not.

applicability: The subject is a pedestrian (ru.aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-165::pedestrian) beginning an authorized diagonal crossing: at this observation its footprint comes to overlap an intersection x (rel.occupies, st.intersection) that it did not overlap at the previous observation, its footprint overlaps a marked crosswalk (st.crosswalk, marked), and it moves diagonally across x: for every lane l with st.lane_enters(l, x) (at least one exists), drv_motion_moving_across_carrier(subject, l) holds with (p.halt_speed_tolerance, p.crossing_motion_cos) and does not hold with (p.halt_speed_tolerance, p.right_angle_crossing_cos). The duty does not apply where LVMC_11_30_140_B_o1 or LVMC_11_30_140_B_o2 is engaged for the subject.
obligation: For every intersection x re-bound with the whole selection of the applicability (rises(rel.occupies(subject, x)) at this observation; at least one lane l with st.lane_enters(l, x); for every lane l with st.lane_enters(l, x), drv_motion_moving_across_carrier(subject, l) with (p.halt_speed_tolerance, p.crossing_motion_cos) and not with (p.halt_speed_tolerance, p.right_angle_crossing_cos)), and for every pedestrian signal head d (dev.pedestrian_signal) with dev.governs(d, x) that the subject faces at this observation: d shows neither dont_walk_steady nor dont_walk_flashing without its countdown attribute. The subject faces d where, with Δ the vector from the subject's kin.position to d's dev.position and h the subject's kin.heading: h·Δ > 0, (h·Δ)² ≥ p.ped_signal_facing_cos² · (Δx² + Δy²), and Δx² + Δy² ≤ p.ped_signal_facing_reach². Where no head governing x is faced, compliant; where whether a faced head governs x is unobserved and its indication would forbid, unknown.

narrowings.why: 'official' is read through the presence of the signal head in the scene.

'the devices pertaining to such crossing movements' is read as the pedestrian signal heads that govern (dev.governs) the intersection whose diagonal crossing begins, and among them those the pedestrian faces across the crossing (ahead of it along its heading, within the facing cone and reach).

'cross only in accordance with the devices' is read at the start of the diagonal crossing (the entry into the intersection) through the indication of those heads: a steady don't-walk, or a flashing don't-walk with no countdown, forbids starting; conduct later in the crossing is not read, and devices other than pedestrian signal heads are not read.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: At an intersection with a marked diagonal crosswalk, a pedestrian steps from the corner into the intersection walking north-east inside the marking while the pedestrian head governing that intersection, ahead of it 25 m away within the facing cone, shows dont_walk_steady.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: Same entry, while the faced head governing the intersection shows walk.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: The pedestrian enters the intersection walking east, at right angles to the north-south lanes: no diagonal crossing begins.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: Same entry as forbid, but the state of the faced pedestrian head is not observed.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: Same entry while the faced head governing the intersection shows dont_walk_flashing with its countdown displayed.

scenarios.name: branch_2
scenarios.narrative: Same entry while the faced head governing the intersection shows dont_walk_flashing without a countdown.

scenarios.name: branch_3
scenarios.narrative: Same diagonal entry, but the scene has no pedestrian signal head at all.

scenarios.name: branch_4
scenarios.narrative: Same entry as forbid, and the faced head shows dont_walk_steady, but it is recorded as governing another intersection, not the one entered: it does not pertain to this crossing.
